posts.cooked: I was playing Omnitron X and was using his power to reveal a card from a deck and "put into play".  Are there rules for what cards can be "put into play"?
posts.raw: I was playing Omnitron X and was using his power to reveal a card from a deck and "put into play".  Are there rules for what cards can be "put into play"?

posts.name: Arcanist Lupus
posts.cooked:
Any card can be put into play (as long as it isn't Limited with a copy already in play).  Ongoings One Shots enter play, and then leave play when their effect finishes resolving.

 

EDIT:  I'm not actually sure how mandatory play abilities work with Limited cards.

posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked:
Note also that you can use Omni-10's Timeshift to get around restrictions like Bunker's Mode cards, or the Swarm of Scarabs in the Tomb of Anubis which prevent you from drawing cards, or the Hostage Situation in Megalopolis which prevents you from playing them - with Timeshift, you aren't drawing a card or playing one - you're revealing it and then putting it into play. The only time this wouldn't work would be if your deck had no cards left, because revealing from a deck doesn't let you reshuffle it.

So really, any card which enters play is being "put into play". It's just that not every card that gets put into play is actually "played".

posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
Just to pick the appropriate nits for the newbie's benefit…

Ameena:

Note also that you can use Omni-10's Timeshift to get around restrictions like Bunker's Mode cards

Er, to clarify, this means you can put a card into play when Turret or Recharge mode says you can't play cards.  Timeshifting a Mode into play still destroys any other Modes currently in play; you're not getting around that "restriction".

or the Swarm of Scarabs in the Tomb of Anubis which prevent you from drawing cards

I wouldn't call that a parallel, since Timeshift doesn't put a card into your hand, just directly into play.  Foresight is what gets a card into your hand when you're not allowed to draw.  If Timeshift puts a card into play which says "you draw a bunch of cards", the Scarabs will still prevent you from doing so.

The only time this wouldn't work would be if your deck had no cards left, because revealing from a deck doesn't let you reshuffle it.So really, any card which enters play is being "put into play". It's just that not every card that gets put into play is actually "played".

Both of these however are exactly correct.

posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
How is it in any way comparable to drawing?  It's putting a card into play, whether or not that card is useful right now.  Drawing a card lets you have that card LATER (unless Citizen Tears is in play).  Tachyon is a sad panda when Omnix Timeshifts her a turn-1 Lightspeed Barrage.  Timeshift does not help Nightmist power her Amulet or let Engine of War Bunker destroy an Ongoing card by giving him a Mode to discard.  And if the fan theory that Sky-Scraper might have a "most cards in hand" mechanic, it will receive no help from Timeshift either.

It's sort of like getting to play a card.  It bears no resemblance to drawing a card other than in removing one card from your deck.
